description.sl: V knjižnici z učiteljico Eleno: izposoditi si in vrniti, izkaznica, roman, strip in pravljica, avtor in junak, poglavje, naslov in platnica, slovar, listati, ilustracija, glasno in tiho brati.
description.en: At the library with Maestra Elena: borrowing and giving back, the library card, the novel, the comic and the fairy tale, the author and the hero, the chapter, the title and the cover, the dictionary, leafing through, the pictures, reading aloud and quietly.
description.de: In der Bücherei mit Maestra Elena: ausleihen und zurückgeben, der Leseausweis, der Roman, der Comic und das Märchen, Autor und Held, das Kapitel, Titel und Einband, das Wörterbuch, blättern, die Bilder, laut und leise lesen.

review: it, sl, en, de: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_it: La biblioteca del paese apre il mercoledì.
words.example_sl: Vaška knjižnica je odprta ob sredah.
words.example_en: The village library opens on Wednesdays.
